title: VA-backed home loan - basics
facts: VA home loans are made by private lenders and backed or guaranteed in part by the Department of Veterans Affairs for eligible borrowers.
Eligible borrowers may be able to purchase with no down payment when the sales price does not exceed the appraised value and lender requirements are met.
VA-backed purchase loans do not require monthly private mortgage insurance.
Eligibility for the VA home-loan benefit is documented through a Certificate of Eligibility, but a COE does not itself guarantee loan approval.
